hypothesis: On the 4-bit Boolean world (|X| = 16) with parameter set Theta = {(0,0), (0,1), (1,0), (1,1)} of joint-parity concentrations and Laplace-smoothed pmf P(theta, x) = (P_hat(theta, x) + 1/16) / 2 where P_hat concentrates mass 1/4 on the 4 worlds sharing theta's joint parity, the LR-vector against theta_0 = (0, 0) together with the uniform-on-fibre kernel jointly realise SIC-A: (a) T1's cross-multiplication characterisation is a biconditional on all 256 world pairs; (b) K's fibre support is a biconditional on all 4 * 16 = 64 (z, x) pairs; (c) K sums to 1 on every fibre; (d) the LR-vector-induced fibre partition equals the joint-parity reference MSS partition (parity{0,1}(x), parity{2,3}(x)) bit-exact -- four fibres of four worlds each.

gates.SFDP_T1_CHARACTERISATION_BICONDITIONAL: For all pairs (x, x') in X * X, q(x) = q(x') iff the pmf cross-multiplication identity P(theta, x) * P(theta', x') = P(theta, x') * P(theta', x) holds for every (theta, theta') in Theta * Theta.
gates.SFDP_FIBRATION_STRUCTURE_BICONDITIONAL: For every (z, x) in image(q) * X, K(z, x) > 0 iff q(x) = z.
gates.SFDP_FIBRE_NORMALISATION_SUMS_TO_ONE: For every z in image(q), the fibre-wise sum sum_x K(z, x) equals 1 exactly under rational arithmetic.
gates.SFDP_LR_PARTITION_EQUALS_JOINT_PARITY_MS: The fibre partition induced by q equals the joint-parity reference MSS partition on X bit-exact: four fibres of four worlds each, matching x |-> (parity{0,1}(x), parity{2,3}(x)).

parameter_set: Theta = {(0,0), (0,1), (1,0), (1,1)} (four parameters, one per joint-parity pair)
smoothing: +1/16 Laplace smoothing (task-spec value), then renormalise by /2

compute.sampling: exact enumeration of the 16-element Boolean world with 4-element Theta; all arithmetic done in Python's fractions.Fraction for bit-exact rational values
